title_original: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938): Check Your Java Services Now
description: Bottom line: A single malformed Base64 string can give an attacker code execution on unpatched Java runtimes, often without logging in. Fixes were released on November 17, 2026. Inventory your Java runtimes, patch identity providers first, and use a startup flag where you cannot patch today. Check Point IPS protection for the public PoC is available now, but patching is still the only complete fix. title_original: The forced audit: how AuditTeam’s OpsAgent framework masks ransomware as consulting
description: How does a ransomware gang sell a “forced audit”? We break down AuditTeam’s OpsAgent implant, its Rust rewrite, and the extortion model demanding a consulting fee to delete stolen data.

title_original: Microsoft agent-framework Compromised: Credential Stealer Targets Azure and CI Pipelines
description: On November 17, 2026 at 20:35 UTC, versions 1.26.1 & 1.26.2 of the Microsoft PyPI package agent-framework were published with an added credential stealer.  The package gets almost 200k downloads a month. The malicious versions have since been quarantined.
